facts.material: steel fabrication with rotating vane cage and drive (assumed)
facts.function: separates pulverized coal particles by size, returning oversize particles to the mill and passing fines to the burners
facts.form: complete stationary classifier unit mounted on a pressurized coal pulverizer

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8474 covers machinery for sorting, screening or separating mineral substances in solid (including powder) form; pulverized coal is a mineral substance
Section XVI note 2(a): the classifier is itself a separating machine of heading 8474 (8474.10), so it is classified as such rather than as a part of the pulverizer (8474.90)
GRI 6: 8474.10.00 sorting, screening, separating or washing machines; suffix .90 stationary (fixed to the mill), not portable

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts line; the classifier performs its own separating function named in 8474.10 (Section XVI note 2(a))
the classifier does not crush or grind; the pulverizer does
the classifier sizes solid mineral particles rather than filtering or purifying a gas; 8474 is more specific for mineral substances
residual heading yields to 8474, which names separating machinery for mineral substances

missing_facts: Is the classifier imported as a complete stand-alone separating unit or as a component/section of a pulverizer without its own drive (then 8474.90.00)?
classification.rationale: A dynamic classifier size-separates pulverized coal, a mineral substance in powder form, so it falls within heading 8474's 'machinery for sorting, screening, separating ... mineral substances'. Under Section XVI note 2(a) a machine that is itself described by 8474.10 stays there even though it works with a pulverizer. NY N252078 (in force) shows CBP applying heading 8474 to mineral size-reduction and screening equipment; no ruling on a coal classifier itself was found, so the stationary line 8474.10.00.90 is chosen with moderate confidence.
